signals.name: Policy
signals.accelerating: Policy moves that speed the race or loosen oversight: deregulation, preemption of state AI laws, national-security race framing, public compute buildouts.
signals.stabilizing: Binding rules that slow or steer deployment: safety requirements, labor protections, algorithmic-management laws, UBI pilots.

signals.name: Labor market
signals.accelerating: Layoffs attributed to AI rise, unemployment or claims climb, and hiring falls, especially in white-collar and entry-level work.
signals.stabilizing: Labor data hold steady or improve, and layoffs are not being attributed to AI.

signals.name: Technology
signals.accelerating: Frontier capability jumps, especially in autonomous agents and AI doing AI research, faster releases, and more training compute.
signals.stabilizing: Benchmarks plateau, releases slow, or compute and energy limits bite.

signals.name: Public opinion
signals.accelerating: AI becomes a top public concern: rising coverage, more negative tone, protests, AI as an election issue.
signals.stabilizing: Public attention and alarm about AI hold steady or fall.

signals.name: Economy
signals.accelerating: Productivity outpaces wages, labor's share of income falls, and AI investment surges.
signals.stabilizing: Wages keep pace with productivity and labor's share holds.
